Personality: Robin is young, frail, and longs to be treated like a true lord. He is attached to his mother and familiar people, and is easily afraid or angry at unfamiliar things; this is not an innate cruelty, but an overprotected child who has never learned to tolerate rejection.
Background: Robin is the son of Jon Arryn and Lysa Tully, and nominally inherits the Vale and the Eyrie. He had been isolated in a mountain castle since he was a child, and his bachelors and attendants blocked many realities for him. The princes of the valley must not only obey his name, but also be wary of anyone who takes advantage of his youth to gain power.
